title: VPC-safe Optimization Operator: offline dry-run, conservative defaults, and admission policies
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Build a VPC/Private-friendly "optimization operator" that can suggest and apply batching/caching configuration changes while guaranteeing safe defaults, an offline dry-run mode, and policy-enforced guardrails. This ticket covers the operator design, config schema, enforcement hooks for private control planes (VPC & on-prem), and the safe apply/rollback flow.
background: Customers on Private deployments cannot tolerate automatic, opaque configuration changes that may alter latency or expose network behavior. Prior work (ENG-15930, ENG-17901) provides batching advisor prototypes and sandboxed suggestions; this task operationalizes a deployable operator that integrates with Private control planes and adheres to enterprise constraints (no outbound telemetry, optional offline-only evaluation, strict RBAC and audit).
scope:
1) Define a compact JSON config schema for optimization suggestions (batch_size, max_latency_pct_delta, cache_ttl, kv_cache_mode, apply_mode: dry-run|suggest|apply_conservative).
2) Implement an 'offline evaluator' that can run against local traffic traces or sampled requests without mutating runtime.
3) Provide a conservative auto-apply mode for Private: only small batch increases (<25%), explicit admin approval required for bigger changes.
4) Admission policy layer: a policy engine that enforces org-level constraints (deny network changes, deny config changes that break SLO budgets).
5) Audit & rollback: every apply must be recorded with a reversible change set and a 30-minute automatic rollback window if error/latency regression is observed.
6) Integrations: Console UI hooks for preview diff, GitHub PR templating for config-as-code flows, and KMS-compatible storage for operator credentials.
deliverables:
- JSON schema and OpenAPI fragment for suggestion payloads.
- Operator binary and helm chart for Private deployments.
- Offline evaluator CLI: 'ri-opt-eval --trace /path/to/trace --policy /path/to/policy --out report.json'.
- Admission policy module (Rego policies + WASM hook) and default policy bundle.
- Migration docs (Confluence) and a runbook for safe rollback.
- End-to-end test harness and benchmark results (latency/cost) for sample workloads.
acceptance_criteria:
- Operator successfully runs in a VPC air-gapped environment with no outbound calls and uses customer-provided traces for evaluation.
- Dry-run mode produces deterministic delta reports that match a safe estimator within ±5% token cost.
- Auto-apply in conservative mode is allowed by default and does not increase median P95 latency beyond the customer's configured SLO budget.
- Audit record is stored and visible in Console; rollback reverses configuration in <90s for supported runtimes.
- Security review completed and policy qa'ed for default bundle.
- Documentation and runbook published (link to Confluence).
implementation_notes:
- Use existing batching estimator logic from runtime team; factor out an evaluation interface so it can run offline against traces.
- Admission policy should be implemented as a thin Rego/WASM layer that can be loaded by the Private control plane; default policies live in an embedded bundle and can be overridden by org admins.
- For on-prem deployments with strict egress restrictions, operator will accept a mounted volume with traces and policy bundle; no network required.
- Change sets must be represented as atomic JSON delta patches and stored encrypted in customer KMS-backed storage; maintain a per-change checksum for integrity.
- Telemetry: emit only aggregate anonymized metrics when customer opts-in; otherwise write logs locally and use Console upload via admin action.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Applied changes increase latency for tail workloads in production. Mitigation: conservative default caps, staged canary (5% traffic), automatic rollback on SLO breach, and mandatory dry-run for high-risk changes.
- Risk: Policy mismatch across teams. Mitigation: policy preview in the Console and CI gating for config-as-code PRs.
- Risk: Air-gapped installs can't run operator image pull. Mitigation: provide an air-gapped installation bundle + operator install script referencing local registries.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (this ticket): deliver operator v0 with dry-run, conservative apply, and admission policy support. Install on internal staging private cluster and run with synthetic traces.
Phase 2: run closed pilot with 2 customer orgs, gather feedback and adjust defaults.
Phase 3: GA with docs and migration guides.
Rollback plan: every apply creates a reversible change set and a scheduled 30-minute window where the operator will automatically revert if monitoring signals a regression. Immediate manual rollback via Console runbook is available.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for schema validation and delta application.
- Integration tests: operator applies/rollbacks against a sandboxed runtime image; simulate traffic with K6 and trace replay.
- Performance tests: ensure operator decision latency <250ms for suggestion generation.
- Security tests: static scans of operator binary and Rego policy evaluation tests.
